title: A Differential-Geometric Framework for Risk-Optimal Asset Reallocation
summary: We develop a differential-geometric framework for risk-optimal portfolio reallocation. A long-only portfolio is represented as a point of the probability simplex, endowed with a positive-definite Riemannian metric combining market covariance risk with position-dependent concentration risk. The cumulative risk of a rebalancing trajectory is identified with its Riemannian length, so the least-risk transition between a current allocation and a Markowitz target is a geodesic.
